column1: # SHA-256 of each file fetch-jsonld.sh stores under test/corpus/jsonld/, read by
# that script after the download (and for files already present). Columns,
# tab-separated: path under test/corpus/jsonld/, sha256. A schemaorg-examples
# source is checked on its NAME.txt download. A change prints a warning and keeps
# the file; CORPUS_STRICT=1 fails the run. Empty or absent means unchecked.
# Hashes record the files this repository's tests were last run against. Most
# rows are pinned to a commit and never change; the remote @context documents
# (w3.org, schema.org, iiif.io) are not, and warn when the publisher edits them.
